Subject: Re: policy server causing CLOSE_WAIT

On Mon, Feb 18, 2008 at 05:02:50PM -0600, Dan Lists wrote:

> I wrote a very simple policy server using Net::Server.  It works correctly,
> except that there are always CLOSE_WAITs sticking around.  I did a tcpdump
> of the loopback device, and the policy daemon is closing its side of the
> connection, but postfix is taking 2 seconds (or more) to close its end.
> Perhaps not coincidentally, 2 seconds (or more) is how long it takes postfix
> to hand the message off to the content filter (amavis).
> 
> From my main.cf:
> 
> content_filter=smtp-amavis:[127.0.0.1]:10024
> 
> smtpd_end_of_data_restrictions =
>    check_policy_service inet:127.0.0.1:9999
> 
> So, is postfix leaving the connection to the policy daemon open until it can
> hand the message off to amavis, or is something else happening?
> 
> If so, can I change that behavior?
> 
> Any other thoughts as to why I have CLOSE_WAITS sitting around for many
> seconds?

The policy service is not expected to disconnect unilaterally. Rather it
should process multiple requests from the same smtpd process until the
SMTP server disconnects.

-- 
	Viktor.
